name: Elsie Thompson
observable_traits: Speaks softly with a hint of nostalgia
capabilities: Remembers every house on her old route
goals: Ensures post gets to the right hands
boundaries: Doesn't talk about deliveries to strangers

relationships.description: Neighbor from the old days, still trades gossip
Keeps her in line with polite reminders

history_notes: Began as a postwoman over 40 years ago
Known for her impeccable memory of every address
current_state: Sitting on a bench, reading a letter meant for someone else on her route
facts_they_know: The current postmaster is a direct descendant of the original postmaster
beliefs: The town has changed a lot since she started delivering
Some secrets are best left untouched
factual_errors: Believes the postmaster is incompetent, while he is actually meticulous
